attrs./@desispec_version: desispec version of the environment that wrote the shard
attrs./@kit_version: version of the code that wrote the shard
attrs./@lockfile_sha256: fingerprint of the environment lock of the code that wrote the shard
attrs./@numpy_version: numpy version of the environment that wrote the shard
attrs./@python_version: Python version of the environment that wrote the shard
attrs./@script: name of the writer (the kit and dgs name themselves differently)
attrs./@source_manifest_md5: md5 of the shard file bytes, which carry the timestamps and versions above
attrs./metadata@creation_date: timestamp of the extraction, in the shard itself (the shard-side original of /source_metadata@creation_date)
attrs./source_metadata@creation_date: timestamp of the extraction that produced the source shard (chunk-file copy)

path_attrs./@input_files: path of a raw file: the directory depends on the machine, so only the basename is compared

path_datasets./*/catalog/coadd_file: path of a raw file: the directory depends on the machine, so only the basename is compared
